Not a version of ascot: the pre-built declaration files ascot checks against when no `--iris` is given, one per IRIS Community release.

Each `iris-community-<release>.d.json.gz` holds the system classes with their members, the include files and the routines of `%SYS`, as the Community image of that release reports them, with the corrections of `src/mask.json` applied. `ascot analyze` downloads the one for `--iris <release>` (the newest it knows by default) into `~/.ascot` on first use, after checking it against the `.sha256` beside it.

The files are regenerated by the `Declarations` workflow (`scripts/prebuilt-declarations.sh`) and replaced in place, so this release moves while its tag stays.
